title: Discovery of molecular gas fueling galaxy growth in a protocluster at z = 1.7
question: Are there additional gas-rich members of the z=1.7 overdensity around the FRII radio galaxy, and how much molecular gas is in them and in the FRII host?

what.value: CO(2-1) luminosity function used to estimate interlopers

evidence.quote: based on the CO luminosity functions derived by the ASPECS project (cite: decarli_2019)
We assumed $r_{21}=0.76$ from the study of star-forming disk galaxies at z=1.5 by (cite: daddi_2015)

what.value: X-ray column density N_H,X ~1.5e24 cm^-2 and MUSE members from Gilli et al.

recipe.method: Datacube of full mosaic within ±3000 km/s of 85.426 GHz, polynomial continuum subtraction, 30 km/s channels, robust 0.5
Custom sliding-window code on S/N cube (local rms in 10-beam regions); reliability assessed with negative cube; grid of S/N_w, N_ch, N_px
3σ-blanked cube defines the extraction region; integrated spectra fit with single or double Gaussian

recipe.goal: derive line luminosity and H2 mass
recipe.method: L'CO from Solomon 1992 formula; M_H2=(alpha_CO/r21) L'
2D Gaussian fit of 3σ moment 0 with CASA task, deconvolved

recipe.goal: SFR, system mass and column density
recipe.method: SFR from Schmidt-Kennicutt relation using gas mass and size; virial mass from velocity dispersion; N_H,ISM for edge-on thin disk
assumptions: disk diameter = a, height 1 kpc, inclination 90 deg

evidence.quote: major axis $a =$ $3.2 \pm 2.0$ arcsec and a minor axis $b =$ $2.0 \pm 1.6$ arcsec
we derive a line-of-sight (LOS) velocity dispersion of ${\sim}$440 km/s
The mean redshift of the system (including all the known members) is z = 1.694 $\pm$ 0.001.

not_stated_but_needed: tclean parameters: cell size, image size, deconvolver, threshold, masking
polynomial order and line-free channels for continuum subtraction
HST reduction (Morishita et al. in prep.)
how the ALMA luminosity-based 3 sigma mass upper limits were computed in detail
score_reason: Archival ALMA data and clear formulae, but imaging parameters, versions and custom code are missing.
rediscovery_reason: Public ALMA project code, numeric results (line fluxes, masses), mostly complete recipe.
